## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive — narrow/weak advance. Confirmations: narrow sector breadth and MAJOR divergence across core ETFs (QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +10.69%), SOXX CORRECTION (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +25.27%), IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +4.89%)) point to mixed internals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit pressure emerging: HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND → credit stress rising (HYG/LQD ↓). Bond sell-off (TLT (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -2.68%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND) and concentrated equity gains (XLK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +15.95%) ABOVE TREND) create a mixed risk backdrop.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Tighter: TLT (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -2.68%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND signals higher yields; HYG/LQD both BELOW TREND indicate tighter credit. Broad FX and macro ratios show no clear tailwind for easing — financial conditions mixed / leaning tighter.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading and tech holding gains but breadth weak: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +15.95%), while XLF (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -2.12%) is showing weakness — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US showing relative resilience: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.35%). EM/china under pressure: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -4.22% | 1M: +4.20%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.79% | 1M: -2.77%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation uneven: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +4.89%) while ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -3.15%) and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +2.83%) show cooling in smaller-cap/speculative flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity bifurcation: Oil ETFs USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +17.79%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +17.54%) strong, while GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -5.18%) shows gold weakness; copper CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +3.25%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy dominance intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +5.10%) both rising and driving sector breadth.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +5.35%) show durable positives. DIVERGENCE: QQQ CORRECTION (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +10.69%), SOXX CORRECTION (1W: -2.26% | 1M: +25.27%) and several 1W vs 1M mismatches create a MAJOR divergence that tempers conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and areas with confirmed momentum (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%)); reduce exposure to long-duration bonds TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -2.68%) and highly speculative ETFs ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -3.15%). Monitor breadth and QQQ/SOXX divergences for a regime shift.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%) if energy momentum continues. BEARISH: XLU (1W: -1.90% | 1M: -5.35%) and XRT (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -6.40%) if defensive/retail weakness persists.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: USO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +17.79%) and BNO (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +17.54%) on continued oil strength. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -5.18%) and SLV (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -3.09%) if haven demand stays weak.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency gauge), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, narrow advance with mixed internals. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.71% | 1M: +5.05%)) and pockets of tech (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +15.95%)) showing strength; watch major divergences in QQQ/SOXX/IBIT that could flip the regime.
